chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Safwan, from al-Ala' ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the Imams (peace be upon him), that he was asked about a man who has sexual relations with a woman, whether he may marry her daughter? He said:
No (he cannot marry the daughter), but if he had a wife, then he had sexual relations with her mother or her sister, the one he has (the wife) is not forbidden to him.

key_terms.يَفْجُرُ: to have sexual relations (specifically outside of marriage or in a context creating a prohibition)

ai.seo_question: Can a man marry the daughter of a woman he had sexual relations with?
ai.summary: This hadith clarifies the specific application of 'ikhtilal' (prohibition due to sexual union) by distinguishing between the general rule and an exception where a man already possesses a wife. It establishes that if a man has relations with a woman's mother or sister while already married to one of them, the prohibition does not extend to the other relative, highlighting the nuanced juristic reasoning in Shia fiqh regarding marital eligibility.
